claims.text: All Elegbara, as the eshu call themselves, honor Eshu, if only as a token of respect, and a few form deep bonds with other orishas as well; they see the orishas at work in the world every day.
The bravest, legend says, may one day join the orishas in the palace above the sky, the highest honor there is.
Without the sidhe's tangled hierarchy, Elegbara settle quarrels openly and forgive as soon as the ordeal is over.
